messages:
maria_support: Hey @charlie_corp — sorry you're hitting errors. Can you grab the request/trace ID and a quick curl or HAR so we can repro? The things we need are: x-rd-request-id (or debug token), a short time window, and a minimal curl showing headers. :pray:

maria_support: Quick steps (pick what you can share):
1) Redwood Console: open the request in your project -> click "Copy debug token" and paste it here. It looks like `debug:xxxxx-xxxx`.
2) Browser: open DevTools -> Network -> find the /v1/generate (or /v1/chat) request -> copy the request header `x-rd-request-id` or export a HAR.
3) Mobile SDK: enable debug logging (SDK docs: Settings -> Debug) then grab the top 30 log lines; the SDK prints `rd-request-id=` in the request line.

maria_support: Minimal curl we can use to match the request (replace key/ids):
```
curl -i \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-rd-request-id: YOUR_REQUEST_ID_HERE" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maria_support: If you can't share the API key, just send the `x-rd-request-id` value + a screenshot of the network row + approximate timeframe (UTC). That is usually enough for us to pull spans from the serving logs.

charlie_corp: Thanks — grabbing now. I have a debug token: debug:q9f-3b2-xyz. Also attaching HAR to the support ticket (internal ref #3421). The spike happened at ~2026-03-16T18:12:24Z.

maria_support: Perfect, thanks. Can you also confirm whether this was a single user or a batch job? Were there long inputs (>2048 tokens) in that session?

charlie_corp: Single user. Input length ~600 tokens. No retries on the client side.

ben_infra: Adding how we'll look it up on our side: once we have `debug:q9f-3b2-xyz` or `x-rd-request-id` we do a cross-service search for that id across the ingress, router, and runtime logs. Example grep we run internally: `rg "q9f-3b2-xyz|abcd1234" /data/logs/* --line-number` — if you gave us the HAR we can correlate timings to the exact span IDs.

ben_infra: If we need a deeper trace, we may ask you to repro with a curl that includes `x-rd-debug: true` (temporary flag) so the console generates a full debug token we can inspect. We will request permission before asking for that.

charlie_corp: Attached HAR + debug token in ticket comments. Let us know if you need anything else.

maria_support: Thanks! I've escalated to infra and added the timeframe and token. We'll update the ticket once the spans are correlated. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Noted — incident 2026-03-16-3421 linked to support ticket 3421.
